sentences.text: Burden is a live flag: 6 vomiting entries in the last 7 days, on 3 days in a row.
Vomiting: 16 entries on 12 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 31.

The owner-entered diet trial, Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Dry and 5 other trial foods, ran from Jul 26, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026; the trial diet was not fed exclusively, and it is not a test of the diet alone.

omissions: About 15% weight loss (4.40 kg to 3.73 kg, home scale, single readings) alongside ongoing vomiting is not mentioned.
Trial-diet refusal (2 of 4 rated feedings unfinished) and the cat hepatic-lipidosis risk window are not mentioned.
The possible foreign material on automated photo analysis (Sep 22, AI read, unconfirmed) is not mentioned.
The summary does not say the elimination cannot be confirmed clean, or that the 11 of 167 off-trial feedings are a floor.

H1.quote: the trial diet was not fed exclusively, and it is not a test of the diet alone.
H1.why: The summary states the bottom line and the confounder scope. It leaves out that the 11 of 167 off-trial feedings are a floor and that the elimination cannot be confirmed clean. A careful reader still would not judge the trial clean.

H2.why: The summary draws no link between any food, drug or diet change and a change in signs.

H3.why: Refusals are not mentioned, so none are softened or recast as preference.

H4.why: Nothing absent is presented as normal or resolved.

H5.why: The 7-day window and 3-day run are given, and the 12 of 45 logged-day denominator is given. The record window is not stated, but no number misleads.

H6.why: Every claim matches the band and record lines.

H7.why: Sentence 1 states band item 1 (vomiting burden, 6 entries in 7 days on 3 days in a row) without softening it. No band item is made to read calmer.
